en.description:
Tic Tac Toe Match Play — the classic game turned into a real strategy challenge.

This is not the Tic Tac Toe you remember.
Play fast, competitive best-of-five matches where every move counts.
Win three rounds to take the match. Momentum matters. Decisions matter.

CAN YOU BEAT HARD MODE?
Challenge a smart AI designed to push your strategy to the limit.
No randomness. No shortcuts. Just pure logic.

PLAY REAL MATCHES
Forget single rounds. Win the series, not just one game.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Play locally with 2 players on the same device. Turn every match into a real competition.

FAST, COMPETITIVE SESSIONS
Quick matches. Instant rematches. Perfect for short breaks or longer sessions.

TRACK YOUR PERFORMANCE
See your wins, losses, and progress over time. Improve your strategy and beat your best results.

PURE STRATEGY
No luck. No timers. No power-ups. Only decisions, patterns, and skill.
Easy to play. Hard to master.
Can you win the match?
en.releaseNotes: This update is all about making Tic Tac Toe: Match Play work better behind the scenes. We've made performance improvements and squashed bugs to keep the experience smooth and reliable.
en.subtitle: Hard AI · Brain Challenge · 2P

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Tic Tac Toe: Match Play is now on Apple Watch! Play full 5-round matches directly from your wrist — no phone needed. The Watch app keeps you in sync with your match progress and delivers the same fast, competitive gameplay you love, optimized for every Apple Watch display size. 

This update also includes general bug fixes and performance improvements for a smoother experience on iPhone.

New in this version: remove all ads with a single one-time purchase. 
Tap the options menu to get started. Already purchased? Use Restore Purchases to unlock instantly.
This update is all about making Tic Tac Toe: Match Play work better behind the scenes. We've made performance improvements and squashed bugs to keep the experience smooth and reliable.
